t2.thesis: SNDK enters the print after a memory-sector run-up on SK Hynix's strong results, with an ~8% implied move and a history of weak reactions despite large beats, so the odds of a gap up are roughly a coin flip.
reasons: Base rate is ~54% overall, but the semis cluster is weaker at 47.9%, so a blend near 52% is reasonable.
Entry open is 10/29, after a sector rally on SK Hynix's results (I10, I11, I25); some good news is already priced in.
Three of the last four prints fell despite large EPS beats (-16%, -5%, -2%), showing a high bar and 'sell the news' behavior (I2).
Guidance of $44-46 EPS (I4) versus a consensus of ~$46.4 puts the bar at or above the top of guidance, and estimates have risen, though the stock is down 40% from its high and short interest is low.
Option-implied move of ~8% with IV about 1.45x realized volatility is symmetric and gives no clear directional signal.
t2.deciding_variable: Whether the Q2 FY27 revenue and EPS guide clearly exceeds the ~$46-50 consensus implied by rising pricing, and whether new multi-year NBM contracts are added.

prior.from: I3 overall validation t0_hit 0.542; AMC 0.538; semis cluster 0.479 (SNDK is memory/semis, hardware-adjacent), blended to about 0.52-0.54

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. The earnings date you mention (2026-10-29) is after today's date (2026-10-28), so that report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how SNDK's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 3-4 points from the ~54% base rate for the weak semis cluster, the bar set above guidance, and the poor post-earnings record, partly offset by a depressed price and bullish memory-sector read-throughs from SK Hynix.

theses.expected: Rise: guidance well above consensus, with more NBM deals and a larger buyback
theses.mechanism: Memory shortage commentary from SK Hynix suggests continued pricing power, and a stock 40% off its high could re-rate on a beat-and-raise.
theses.wrong_if: Guided EPS lands near or below ~$50, or gross margin stalls at about 84-85%.

theses.expected: Fall: results are strong but the stock sells off as in the last three prints
theses.mechanism: Pricing peak fears and the sector run-up into the print leave little room, with the bar above the high end of guidance.
theses.wrong_if: The stock opens above the entry price despite an in-line guide.

theses.expected: Flat or mixed gap with a large move in either direction
theses.mechanism: An 8% implied move means the direction is driven by guidance details rather than the EPS beat.
theses.wrong_if: The open-to-open move is under about 2%.

key_observations: Fiscal Q2 revenue and EPS guidance versus consensus
Gross margin trajectory and the pricing versus volume split
Number and size of new NBM agreements and datacenter revenue
Capex or supply expansion plans and buyback pace
Seagate-style reaction: strong results but a sell-off
